page.layout: One printed title page: the title block at the top, a woodcut device in the centre, the imprint below; a manuscript ownership inscription at the foot. No margin text.

main_text.l: butæ, quæ adeò perspicuæ sunt, vt

page.notes: Manuscript annotations, not printed text, and left out: shelf mark "122" and "Phys. 9. 14." at top left, a small "R" in pencil at left margin, the ownership inscription "Su Ioh. Georgy à Werdenstein" at the foot, and the ink flourish at top right. Device: an oval woodcut with the motto MATVRA. Words "MATVRA" appear on the device, not transcribed as text. Line breaks follow the printed lines. The printed "φυσι-" and "κῆς" are Greek as printed; the Greek of the second line of the title should be checked against the scan, as the scan is partly obscured by ink at "φυσι-". The date "M.D. LXXXIIII." is printed as shown. Several letters on the title are slightly blurred by the ink strokes at top right, notably around "INSTITVTIONES" and "PARTES"; the readings above are the most likely, not certain.
